ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a butterfly life cycle with four pictures connected by arrows. The top-left picture shows small eggs on a leaf. The bottom-left picture shows caterpillar-like larvae on a leaf. An arrow leads from the larvae to the bottom-right picture, which shows a chrysalis-like form hanging from a plant. Another arrow leads upward to the top-right picture of an adult butterfly. Reasoning: The question asks for the non-feeding stage between the larva and adult in butterfly metamorphosis. The chrysalis stage between the caterpillar/larva and adult butterfly is biologically called the pupa.
